planSteps.description: Click on any bracket match cell to open a match detail page
Read through all visible analysis paragraphs

Verify the analysis text does not contain obvious placeholder content such as 'lorem ipsum', 'TBD', 'Coming soon', 'Insert analysis here', 'PLACEHOLDER', or repeated identical sentences. The text should appear to be real, written analysis about the specific match.
